## Changes
- **Bolder card titles** – service names and other card titles (e.g. *Radarr*, *Active downloads*, *Appearance*) are now bold (800), slightly larger (14 px) and use the main text colour instead of grey, so each card's title stands out clearly in every theme. Version numbers next to the names stay subtle.

## Upgrade

**Docker**
```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/moordrak/arrhub:1.6.1   # or :latest
docker compose up -d                          # if you use docker-compose.yml
```

**Proxmox LXC** (on the Proxmox host)
```bash
pct exec <CTID> -- bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

**Debian / Ubuntu**
```bash
bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

Your existing `config.json` is kept.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/moordrak/arrhub/compare/v1.6.0...v1.6.1
